value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of the minimum direction-dependent projected-area variance across all fixed icosahedral 12+20 normal-direction surface area measures. Exact anti-correlation yields a uniquely preferable interior convex polytope with a four-to-twelve-fold reduction in relative brightness variance compared with the Platonic endpoints, together with an equality/stability law. It is neither an arbitrary slice nor a special case directly supplied by endpoint values.
